semantics: bounded fixed-point affine / global state as normative procedural state. A SetAffine transition (tag 0x30) attaches a canonical Q8 fixed-point 2D placement to one instance: destination pixel (x, y) samples the object at (su, sv) = ((a*x + b*y + c) >> 8, (d*x + e*y + f) >> 8), where the signed >> 8 is floor division (the canonical rounding) and each coefficient is |.| <= 2^24 Q8 units (1 source pixel = 256 units). There is no floating point in the normative path. A sample inside the object rectangle paints it (with identical fill/raster/bound-palette-index kind semantics as the plain placement); a sample outside leaves the underlying canvas; an overflowing accumulation is ArithmeticOverflow (typed). Whole-pixel translation, integer multiples of 90 deg rotation, and integer zooms are exact in Q8; general rotation/zoom/pan parameters are Q8 approximations whose exactness gap is closed by the residual algebra (F = M(state) (+) R). The identity affine deactivates (never stored); while attached the plain (x, y) placement is dormant and is restored on deactivation. Affine, velocity, and trajectory state on one instance are mutually exclusive; affines die with their instances (ClearInstances). Painting scans the whole canvas, so cumulative per-materialization affine sample work is capped by Limits.max_affine_work (typed MaterializationBudgetExceeded at materialization; parse stays cheap because the work only happens where frames are materialized). New Limits field: max_affine_work (default 8 full 1920x1080 canvases). Accounting: account_stream walks tag 0x30 (transition_bytes += 29).

Phase L is procedural *state* mechanics: affine discovery inside the raster-origin inverse encoder is deliberately not added here (the flattening tax above is measured, not hidden); trajectory/palette/affine discovery and region-residual composites are Phase O/Q surface.

Quarter-turn/zoom/pan helpers and the independent affine painter live in src/demo.rs; the normative map and coefficient checks live in src/affine.rs; mutual exclusivity and lifetime semantics in src/state.rs.
The affine court reference painter accumulates per-row incrementally (nux += a per pixel) while the materializer computes direct products per pixel -- a shared arithmetic bug cannot mask a mismatch.

Residual-closure court: only 58 of 4096 tile pixels differ between the best Q8 30-degree approximation and the float render -- the exactness gap of an 8-bit fixed-point camera map is a small edge set, closed by one persistent sparse patch.
